items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: Nick Kenny, he was a columnist in the news or something and he wrote lyrics for songs.

ctx.x: Nick Kenny, he was a columnist in the news or something and he wrote lyrics for songs. And this was one of his, it’s a sentimental thing, goldmine — and the other one was “There’s a goldmine in the sky far away.” So I sang them.
